host.notes: Rootless user/mount namespaces were used. Physical build, Swift-stage, and home-directory prefixes were redacted.

commands.purpose: Create two independently built, hash-verified Swift stages at distinct physical prefixes.
Reproduce the pinned GNU Binutils stage against both Swift prefixes.
Run two clean offline builds behind the previous complete-file hash gate and retain the expected path-change mismatch evidence.
Repeat both clean offline builds after accepting the qualified complete-file hash.

commands.command: cmp <accepted-a>/xtool/xtool <accepted-b>/xtool/xtool; cmp <accepted-a>/xtool/libXADI.so <accepted-b>/xtool/libXADI.so; env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH <each>/xtool --version; env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH <each>/xtool --help
commands.purpose: Require complete byte identity, absence of private prefixes, post-acceptance runtime behavior, dynamic dependency resolution, and reuse.
Verify the neutral parent can be created on a fresh host path, only that parent is overlaid, unrelated /tmp entries remain visible, and the logical child does not persist outside the namespace.

expectedBehavior: A fresh Linux host requires no OpenCode-created path. The installer creates a neutral mountpoint and each rootless namespace creates the fixed logical child privately while preserving complete-file verification.
observedBehavior: The neutral host mountpoint was created from an absent state. Only that directory was overlaid in the namespace; unrelated /tmp entries remained visible and the logical child was absent afterward. Two clean offline builds from distinct physical, Swift, and Binutils prefixes produced identical final xtool/XADI bytes and static ELF metadata. No physical prefix or superseded OpenCode path was present. Both production-gated builds and reuse passed, and runtime checks ran only after complete hash acceptance.
limitations: Qualification covers glibc Linux x86_64 hosts that permit unprivileged user and mount namespaces.
It does not independently requalify signing, deployment, launch, device runtime, Rider, or Uno.
nextDecision: Rerun the installer from the successfully restored pre-install state and continue the authentic-Xcode root bootstrap gate.

redaction.notes: Exact inputs, outputs, command shapes, namespace behavior, and bounded results are retained without private prefixes.
